Summaries of the distances

Source: R/exploratory_analysis.R
summarise_distance.Rd

Computes the distances between the unique locations in the dataset and returns summary statistics.

Usage

summarise_distance(data, distance_crs = NULL, distance_units = c("km", "m"))

# S3 method for class 'RiskMap_distance_summary'
print(x, digits = 3, ...)

Arguments

data

an object of class sf containing point geometries.

distance_crs

NULL to retain an existing projected CRS, or automatically reproject longitude/latitude data to the CRS from propose_crs() (with a message naming the CRS and the units of distance). Alternatively, a CRS to reproject data to, which must itself be projected. A warning of class riskmap_warning_crs is raised when the CRS used distorts distances by more than 1% over the data.

distance_units

Character string, either "km" or "m", indicating whether the distances used are expressed in kilometers or meters. Defaults to "km".

x

an object returned by summarise_distance().

digits

the number of significant digits to print. Defaults to 3.

...

further arguments, currently ignored.

Value

a named numeric vector of class RiskMap_distance_summary containing the following components

min

the minimum distance

max

the maximum distance

mean

the mean distance

median

the median distance

The values are stored in full. Its print() method shows them to digits significant digits, with the number of unique locations and the distance units.

Examples

data(italy_sim)

summarise_distance(italy_sim)
#> ── Distances between locations ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> 200 unique locations, with distances in km.
#>    min    max   mean median 
#>   4.95  1,144    440    411
